scientific_integrity: The scalar absolute-stability interval is not claimed as a new method; the specific joint fixed-period stability and sharp additive-noise amplification law is the finding. No independent replication has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-periodic normalized steps and scalar real decay only; not general adaptive meshes or multirate PDEs.
Independent additive disturbances with common variance at each update, not a universal relative-roundoff model.
Stationary variance limit is taken before the singular small-step limit.
Specialist precedence in older variable-step multistep stability literature cannot be entirely excluded.
title: Stable alternating Adams–Bashforth decay with a singular noise floor
